theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_ll_gws_pairing_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (C : ℝ≥0) (f : Eucl n → ℝ), IsOpen Ω → LipschitzOnWith C f Ω → ∀ b b' : Eucl n → Eucl n, IntegrableOn b Ω (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) → IntegrableOn b' Ω (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) → |(∫ w in Ω, fderiv ℝ f w (b w)) - ∫ w in Ω, fderiv ℝ f w (b' w)| ≤ C * ∫ w in Ω, ‖b w - b' w‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
